name: superpower-writing
description: Self-contained CS/systems/ML academic-writing plugin from research ideation to reviewer response. It drafts an evidence-backed IMRAD skeleton under claim-first discipline, verifies citations, creates figures, and supports rebuttals. Read-only academic consultation runs Codex and Hermes concurrently with separate evidence-linked handoffs, no voting or synthetic consensus, strict unpublished-material confirmation, Codex read-only isolation, and Hermes workspace-change detection. Scientific image generation remains a Codex-only exception. All model verdicts are advisory and require source verification.
